race.comment: The well-related VEOMAS (4) (half to G1 winner Seabrook) is a former Victorian who hasn't been too far away in both runs since joining the new stable and should find this easier than what he faced down south. Trust that Gollan has him up to the mark now second-up and should be right there at the business end. FAWUNDERPAR (5) also hails from a handy family (half to G2 winner Blueberry Hill) and has hit the top-four in all three career outings to date. Only needs some luck from the sticky draw to be featuring in the finish. MAJOR HOT (13) has placed over this course and distance and gets in light with the claim. Worth serious consideration. FRACUS (10) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown some ability at the trials and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. Respect any push in betting. CITY BOUND (16) next in line.
